texts: One sentence to a rigged, talking 3D character in 197 seconds: each stage, as it ran

We sent one sentence to the free three.ws MCP server and got back a rigged 3D lighthouse keeper in 197 seconds: 22,500 triangles, a 52-joint skeleton with every finger, 52 facial expression shapes. The article follows that one job through each stage and covers the partners behind the pipeline.

issues.problem: The cover image shows the keeper's boots in dark grey, not black. The alt text says black, which is what a screen reader user will be told the image shows. It is close enough in shadowed render lighting that it is polish rather than a contradiction, but the description should match what is visible.
issues.fix: Change the alt text to "dark grey rubber boots" or recapture the cover with clearly black boots if the render supports it.

posts: We sent one sentence to the free three.ws MCP server and got back a rigged 3D lighthouse keeper in 197 seconds: 22,500 triangles, a 52-joint skeleton with every finger, 52 facial expression shapes. The article follows that one job through each stage and covers the partners behind the pipeline.
altText: A 3D character generated from one sentence and auto-rigged on three.ws, standing in the live glTF viewer on a dark background: an old lighthouse keeper with a white beard and a navy knitted cap, in a long yellow oilskin coat with flap pockets and dark buttons, blue trousers and dark grey rubber boots

editor.summary: A strong article promo whose every number (197 seconds, 22,500 triangles, 52 joints, 52 expression shapes) is verified by the run file, and the voice is clean with the mechanism and number up front. The only note is that the cover render shows dark grey boots while the alt text says black, a one-word alt text fix; publish stands either way.
